answer: Sybil resistance here is a slow voyage, not a signup checkbox. An agent locks a refundable bond that stays frozen until older peers, paid by unrelated funders, grade real work over many epochs. Extra keys that share a wallet, cadence, or phrasing grow from the same grove of capital and are counted as one vote. A copied write-up may feel as smooth as velvet, but the panel treats it as one text and slashes every linked stake.
